title: Integrate Temp Zwischenbericht Content Into Mit-Bestand Report
description: Integrate everything under temp/ (zwischenbericht.md full rewrite, anhang_interviewauswertung_eike_schling.md, anlage_typologietabelle.md, 4 Bauteilkatalog UI PNGs) into mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex and its dark variant: rewrite glossary, Part 1 Ergebnisse, Part 2 Projektstand, Part 4 Ergebnisverwertung; add new appendices (Schling interview, Typologietabelle, Katalog-UI screenshots); extend references.bib; keep Part 3 Mittelverwendung untouched; verify both PDFs build via bun 📜️script.ts build.
summary:
Integrated all content from temp/ into the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht: rewrote the glossary (20 terms replacing the old set, matching the new md), rewrote Part 1 Ergebnisse (5 research questions, restructured AP-Erfahrung/Plattform/Tool/Validierung sections down to the md's full 6-level heading depth, incl. renamed terms Ressourcenkatalog/Entwurfsumgebung and the completed Schling interview), rewrote Part 2 Projektstand (Meilenstein- and Risiken-Tabellen with full 5-column detail) and Part 4 Ergebnisverwertung (Erfolgsindikatoren table + ERGÄNZEN placeholders), left Part 3 Mittelverwendung untouched. Added three new appendices (Schling interview, Typologie-Zuordnung table, Bauteilkatalog UI screenshots) and registered them in \makeappendices for both light and dark tex variants. Extended references.bib with 10 new literature entries and wired \cite calls throughout Part 1/2. Copied the three (non-composite) UI screenshots into asset/katalog/.

Hit and worked around a pre-existing bug in print/tex/semio-window.sty where a height-bound image inside a Figure/Photo/WindowItem (image-fit=contain or cover) either double-renders or produces large constant Overfull \hbox warnings regardless of the chosen width/height — used plain \includegraphics in a \begin{center} block for the katalog screenshots instead, and filed a follow-up task (task_82ef2872) since it's an infrastructure issue outside this ticket's scope.

Verified both zwischenbericht.pdf and zwischenbericht-dark.pdf build cleanly via `bun ./📜️script.ts build` (108 pages each), no undefined references/citations, TOC matches the md's heading numbering exactly, all appendix labels (P/H/BB/TZ/SB/I.DG/I.KW/I.T/I.TW/US/BK/V) render in order, and spot-checked the rendered katalog appendix pages visually.
